name: Toaster
description: Stack host for the imperative toast() API (toast(title, options) plus normal/success/danger/info/warning shortcuts and dismiss(id?)). Renders the newest card in front, evicts the oldest past max, pauses auto-dismiss while hovered or focused, and plays the exit animation before removal.

props.name: duration
props.description: 자체 duration이 없는 토스트의 자동 닫힘(ms).

props.name: max
props.description: 동시에 보이는 최대 개수 — 넘치면 가장 오래된 것이 닫혀요.

limitations: No toaster queue; place podo-toast cards yourself.
SSR renders the empty stack; the client island (podo-ui/hono/client) mounts the same React Toaster and exposes window.podo.toast.
Apps place Toast cards in their own overlay.

aria: each toast keeps its own live region (status, or alert for danger)
keyboard: Focus inside the stack pauses auto-dismiss
